programme.title: Larry Graham - Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Maybe this time
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett’s captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I’ve Got Five Dollars”, “It Don’t Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter - Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane - Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: James Brown - James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène - Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius - Fannie Mae
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius’s electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca - The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seun Kuti - Seun Kuti & Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent. Three-quarters of Egypt 80's current line-up is composed of musicians who didn’t only play with Fela Kuti, but often were arrested and harassed alongside the founder of the Afrobeat.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: James Brown - James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here. Having recently graduated from Berklee College of Music in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, Ozone performed a mesmerizing solo concert for the festival’s audience. Today, Ozone is among the most recognized Japanese jazz musicians in the world.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn - Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Chick Corea, John Patitucci & Dave Weckl - Chick Corea Akoustic Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1989, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. In this concert Corea returned to his roots, performing jazz standards and originals in a stripped-down trio setting of piano, bass and drums. With Dave Weckl (drums) and John Patitucci (bass), this highly interactive trio actually had its beginnings in 1985 with Chick Corea's Elektric Band.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés - Lorena's Tango
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: John Coltrane - I want to talk about you
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil’ ol’ band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Sting - Bring On The Night
programme.desc: Documents the preparation and rehearsals for Sting's first solo concert, as well as his supporting band's opinions on their leader and his controversial efforts.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career. Duets II: The Great Performances is a testament to the artistry and dedication of Tony Bennett, beloved by the performers who sing with him and audiences around the world. Starring Andrea Bocelli, Michael Bublé, Natalie Cole, Sheryl Crow, Aretha Franklin, Josh Groban, Faith Hill, Norah Jones, Lady Gaga, kd lang, John Mayer, Willie Nelson, Alejandro Sanz, Queen Latifah, Carrie Underwood, Amy Winehouse.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen - Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: London Calling: Live in Hyde Park is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette - Live at Montreux 2012
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. Her voice is instantly recognisable and she is a consummate live performer. On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour in support of her latest album "Havoc And Bright Lights". It was her third appearance at the festival. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. Music video by Alanis Morissette __© 2012 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan’s expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: Love, Of Course
programme.desc: When widowed mother Amy moves her daughter Cara to her college dorm, Amy finds herself searching for the next step. While at the university, Amy gets an offer she can't refuse and meets Noah and discovers a new life of her own.

programme.title: Loving Leah
programme.desc: When Leah's husband Benjamin dies suddenly, Benjamin's brother Jake is stunned to learn he is expected to marry Leah to carry on the name. Jake suggests to Leah that they get married and maintain a secretly platonic relationship.

programme.title: The Sweetest Heart

programme.desc: When Natalie and Eric each inherit a share of an old bakery, this unlikely pair must decide what's in store for this historic landmark. When both of their careers come to a screeching halt, an opportunity presents itself.

programme.desc: When a talented chef returns to her Texas hometown, she winds up entering the town's famous BBQ cookoff and gets more than she bargained for when the surprise judge turns out to be her high school love. Stars Autumn Reeser.

programme.desc: Fired from her job as a reality TV host, Natalie returns home for Valentine's Day, only to find herself running the town festival's auction with her ex-fiance thanks to two scheming mothers. Bethany Joy Lenz, Luke Macfarlane.

programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a down-on-her-luck young woman who falls into a job as a personal assistant to a star quarterback. He's never had a female assistant before and she knows nothing about football.

programme.title: Unleashing Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: Elizabeth gets the opportunity of showing her dog in a New York dog show. The judge, Donovan Darcy, comes across as aristocratic and rude, and a chain of misunderstandings unfold, complicating their attraction to one another.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: Elizabeth and Donovan are very different people; she's a down-to-earth high school teacher and he's a reserved New York businessman. So, when they get engaged, their trip to the altar is lively and unpredictable.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas
programme.desc: Prince Leopold, heir to the throne of Cordinia, falls in love with Emily Taylor, a humble seamstress from Philadelphia. But the young prince's wishes are challenged by his mother, who wants him to marry royalty.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts? Stars Lacey Chabert, Will Kemp.

programme.title: The Dancing Detective: A Deadly Tango
programme.desc: A no-nonsense detective must reluctantly team up with a charismatic British dance star in order to solve a murder. Stars Lacey Chabert, Will Kemp.

programme.title: Crossword Mysteries: A Puzzle to Die For
programme.desc: After several of her puzzles are linked to the murder of an art gallery owner, a crossword puzzle editor teams up with a no nonsense detective to stop a killer in their midst. Stars Lacey Chabert, Brennan Elliott.

programme.desc: Tess dives into Logan's murder investigation of her friend who was about to propose with her help. As she grows closer to the truth, she fears it could ruin everyone's happily ever after. Starring Lacey Chabert, Brennan Elliott.

programme.desc: After A-list actress, Alex Allen, has an epic Hollywood meltdown, she is in need of some positive publicity. Salvation comes in the form of a small town boy's video "Promposal" in which the student invites Alex to prom.

programme.desc: Danny proposes to Sara and reveals he is the prince of St. Ives. They need his disapproving parents' blessing. Sara must fight to remain true to herself, while adjusting to this new lifestyle.

programme.title: A Picture of Her
programme.desc: Beth unwittingly becomes the subject of an award-winning magazine's cover and goes on a quest to uncover the true identity of the mystery photographer who snapped her photo. Stars Tyler Hynes, Rhiannon Fish.

programme.title: Just My Type
programme.desc: Vanessa interviews author Martin Clayborne and reevaluates her writing career. Stars Bethany Joy Lenz, Brett Dalton.

programme.title: The Reluctant Royal
programme.desc: Philly mechanic Johnny is surprised to learn that his long-lost father is a duke. But the duke isn't quite what he expected, nor are his growing feelings for the duke's advisor Prudence. Stars Andrew Walker, Emilie de Ravin.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Wedding
programme.desc: A meddling woman wins her sister an all-paid-for Beverly Hills Wedding, but is disappointed to learn her ex will be invited along to help plan. Stars Brooke D'Orsay & Brendan Penny.

programme.title: Double Scoop
programme.desc: Nora discovers the best ice cream and hopes to land them as a client. Her sweet dreams hit a snag when her former colleague James has the same idea. Old sparks begin to melt the frosty tension. Stars Taylor Cole, Ryan McPartlin.

programme.title: Falling Into Place
programme.desc: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list. Stars Alvina August, Nathan Witte.

programme.desc: Tee is a Chinese American pottery artist who meets new community center handyman Will. As she learns about her family's traditions through art, can she and Will save the center from closure? Stars Janel Parrish, Chris McNally.

programme.title: Junebug
programme.desc: Juniper, a book editor turning 40, is magically reconnected with an eight-year-old version of herself who questions her life choices, including the dream of writing her own stories. Stars Autumn Reeser, Aaron O'Connell.

programme.title: Sand Dollar Cove
programme.desc: Stamford developer Elli works on acquiring beachfront property in Sand Dollar Cove, a quaint Connecticut beach town, but falls for the town's charm and property owner in the process. Chad Michael Murray, Aly Michalka, Clare Bowen.

programme.desc: Contestants on The One, Stephanie and Oliver try to determine if they're fated to be together. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Stephanie and Alex, the handsome ranch owner who acts as their guide. Stars Pascale Hutton and Sam Page.

programme.desc: As Valentine's Day nears, a matchmaker is tasked by her mentor to find a match for an entrepreneur who believes staying single is the key to success. Stars Taylor Cole and Ryan Paevey.

programme.title: An Unexpected Valentine
programme.desc: A chance encounter on Valentine's Day brings Hannah and Finn together as they race through New York City to return a lost engagement ring and save one couple's special day. Stars Lacey Chabert, Robert Buckley.

programme.title: Betty's Bad Luck in Love
programme.desc: Cursed from childhood to fail at romance, Betty's relationships have always ended in disaster. But when she meets Alex, she's tempted to try once more. Can true love prevail over a curse? Stars Laci J. Mailey, Marco Grazzini.

programme.title: The Love Heist
programme.desc: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala. Stars Lyndsy Fonseca, Peter Porte.

programme.title: Lost in Paradise
programme.desc: When the founder of a high-end fashion company gets marooned on an "deserted" island with a chef, romance blossoms as they work together to survive. Starring Lacey Chabert and Ian Harding.

programme.title: Paris, Revisited
programme.desc: Nonprofit executive Chelsea is in Paris to secure a major donor, but begins an unexpected journey across Europe to reconnect with her past loves. Stars Lacey Chabert, Scott Michael Foster, Henry Czerny, and Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Missing the Boat
programme.desc: Strangers Kelly and Parker both end up on the same Italian cruise, but after missing the boat during a stop, they're forced to team up and race across southern Italy to catch up. Stars Emilie Ullerup and Kristoffer Polaha.

programme.desc: Through a series of coincidences, known as Godwinks, Paula and Gery find their paths keep crossing at Christmas on Martha's Vineyard, as if they are destined for each other. Stars Kathy Lee Gifford, Kimberly Sustad, Paul Campbell.

programme.title: Following Yonder Star
programme.desc: A former television star waits out a scandal in Vermont. She becomes close with the innkeeper and his daughter while she helps him direct the local children's Christmas pageant. Stars Brooke D'Orsay and John Brotherton.

programme.title: A Maple Valley Christmas
programme.desc: Rancher Erica has spent her whole life working the family farm with her mother and sister. When Aaron arrives and disrupts her plans, she starts to question what it is she actually wants. Starring Peyton List and Andrew Walker.

programme.title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: Single mom Jennifer Cullen is having trouble finding joy in the holiday season. Then her Uncle Ralph arrives at her home with the young, handsome Morgan Derby. Morgan's love of Christmas, and life, is contagious.

programme.title: Santa Tell Me
programme.desc: A design show host finds a letter from Santa promising to meet her true love, a man named Nick, by Christmas Eve. Meeting three Nicks complicates her search. Stars Erin Krakow, Daniel Lissing, Benjamin Ayres, Christopher Russell.

programme.title: Single on the 25th
programme.desc: Despite being lonely during the holidays, Nell finds a fresh outlook when her neighbor Cooper shows her the joy of celebrating Christmas single. Starring Lyndsy Fonseca and Daniel Lissing.

programme.title: The Sweetest Christmas
programme.desc: A struggling pastry chef must embrace the Christmas spirit or risk losing both the contest and a second chance at love. Stars Lacey Chabert and Lea Coco.

programme.title: Pride, Prejudice, and Mistletoe
programme.desc: When Darcy returns home to plan a Christmas charity event with her old rival Luke, she realizes what is important in life by repairing her relationship with her father and finding love. Stars Lacey Chabert and Brendan Penny.

programme.desc: After getting fired from her job, Allie accepts a temp job as governess to Princess Theodora. A spark forms between Allie and Theodora's father Maximillion, the King of Winshire.

programme.title: Picture a Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: A photographer who travels the world takes a few days off around the holidays to care for her grandmother. While there, she meets her neighbor, DAVID who needs help watching his 7 year old nephew. Stars Merritt Patterson, Jon Cor.

programme.title: Tidings for the Season
programme.desc: News anchor, Adam, is challenged by superfan, Robbie, to report good news at Christmas. Adam reluctantly takes him under his wing and finds a connection with Robbie's mom. Stars Tamera Mowry-Housley, BJ Britt, Elijah-Justus Lewis.

programme.title: Checkin' It Twice
programme.desc: A journeyman hockey player falls for a real estate agent in a career crisis when he's traded to her hometown and moves into the cottage in her hockey loving family's backyard. Starring Kim Matula and Kevin McGarry.

programme.title: A Reason for the Season
programme.desc: In order to earn her trust fund and with the help of a handsome local attorney, Evie is tasked with granting Christmas wishes to the people who saved her life on the night of her birth. Stars Taylor Cole and Kevin McGarry.

programme.title: Christmas Getaway
programme.desc: Hoping to spend the holiday relaxing, a travel writer takes a traditional Christmas vacation for the first time. Through a rental mix up, she finds herself double booked for the holiday. Stars Bridget Regan, Travis Van Winkle.

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Chiefs Love Story (Extended Cut)
programme.desc: Chiefs superfan Alana tries to win the Fan of the Year Award as a Christmas gift for her family, falling in love with someone in the Chiefs front office along the way. Stars Hunter King, Tyler Hynes.

programme.title: On the 12th Date of Christmas
programme.desc: Two co-workers vying for the same promotion are tasked to create a 12 Days of Christmas scavenger hunt to promote the premiere of a new hotel. Stars Mallory Jansen and Tyler Hynes.

programme.desc: Interior designer Lacey and the maid-of-honor in her best friends wedding finds herself snowed in at the Christmas Cottage, alongside her ex-boyfriend. Stars Merritt Patterson and Steve Lund.

programme.title: Christmas Made to Order
programme.desc: Steven recruits holiday coordinator Gretchen to bring Christmas joy to his family. Neither expected the Christmas spirit to bring them closer to each other. Stars Alexa PenaVega and Jonathan Bennett.

programme.title: Christmas Under the Lights
programme.desc: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organize the Christmas Carnival and works with a handsome artist to honor her mother. Starring Heather Hemmens, Marco Grazzini.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
programme.desc: When organized caterer Lexi and chill snowboarder Ridge notice a spark between their single parents, they begrudgingly team up to set them up. Stars Amanda Schull, Victor Webster, Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Countdown to Murder
programme.desc: When the owners of a popular grocery store chain are killed, Billie finds macabre clues linking the deaths to a children's countdown song, Five Little Ducks. Stars Holly Robinson Peete and Rick Fox.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Death by Design
programme.desc: Chef Billie Blessings' best friend Marian is hired to redecorate the TV studio. When Marian's twin sister is murdered, Billie must investigate their close friends to find the killer. Stars Holly Robinson Peete, Rick Fox.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder Ever After
programme.desc: TV host Billie Blessings finds bones in the basement of an old friend's house, unearthing a dark secret that threatens to unravel the lives of the most powerful people in her city. Stars Holly Robinson Peete, Colin Lawrence.

programme.title: Crimes of Fashion: Killer Clutch
programme.desc: An American psychologist, hired to coach a fashion designer, helps a guarded French detective unravel a list of fashionable suspects after a murder happens backstage of a Paris fashion show. Stars Brooke D'Orsay, Gilles Marini.

programme.title: The Jane Mysteries: Inheritance Lost
programme.desc: Singer Jane DaSilva inherits the family foundation which finds justice for those who aren't able to help themselves. Together with Detective John Cameron she brings hope to many hopeless cases. Stars Jodie Sweetin, Stephen Huszar.

programme.title: Family Practice Mysteries: Coming Home
programme.desc: A former Army surgeon moves back to her hometown and joins a practice of family doctors, but when she's drawn into solving the mysterious death of a patient, her quiet life becomes upended. Stars Amanda Schull, Brendan Penny.

programme.title: Gourmet Detective Pilot
programme.desc: A chef turned culinary sleuth is partnered with a beautiful detective to unravel the clues surrounding the unexpected death of a guest at a prestigious dinner party. Stars Dylan Neal, Brooke Burns and Matthew Kevin Anderson.

programme.title: A Healthy Place to Die: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
programme.desc: When Henry, the Gourmet Detective, is invited as a guest speaker at a luxury resort spa, he quickly finds himself at the center of another murder. Stars Dylan Neal and Brooke Burns.

programme.title: Death al Dente: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
programme.desc: San Francisco homicide detective Maggie Price and former, world-class chef Henry Ross are on the case once again. The crime-solving odd couple investigates the murder of Henry's friend.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Buried: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
programme.desc: Henry and Maggie attend party of a local publisher, where his son and stepson reenact a historical dual. Someone, however, has loaded the pistol with a real musket ball, so when son pulls the trigger, he kills his stepbrother.

programme.title: Roux the Day: A Gourmet Detective Mystery
programme.desc: Henry and Maggie find themselves in a murder mystery where secrets hidden within a treasured recipe book have dire consequences for all who own it. Starring Dylan Neal and Brooke Burns.

programme.title: One Bad Apple: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: Hannah meets a new side of law & order as she investigates a murder and crosses paths with by-the-books prosecuting attorney Chad Norton. Meanwhile, Delores has a secret. Stars Alison Sweeney, Victor Webster and Barbara Niven.

programme.title: A Sprinkle of Deceit: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: Hannah and Chad flirt with their own paths to solve the same murder while working to clear a colleague who is implicated in the crime. Meanwhile, Delores gets her big break. Stars Alison Sweeney, Victor Webster and Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Reality Bites: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: Hannah's favorite reality show takes over The Cookie Jar. When the producer is found dead, Hannah and Norman team up to track down the killer. Chad invites Hannah to court. Stars Alison Sweeney, Victor Webster, and Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Pie to Die For: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: When Hannah's customer and Delores' theater rival is murdered, Hannah must find her killer in order to save her mother's reputation. Chad and Hannah's romance blossoms. Stars Alison Sweeney, Victor Webster, and Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: Hannah finds a body at the grand re-opening of the Lake Eden Inn. When a storm traps everyone inside, Hannah must find the culprit before the road clears and the killer escapes. Stars Alison Sweeney, Victor Webster, Barbara Niven.

programme.title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial. Movie #14.

programme.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: To the Moon and Back
programme.desc: The POstables take a road trip to find the recipient of a lost letter and track down a musician who is the key to solving the case. Stars Eric Mabius, Kristin Booth, Yan-Kay Crystal Lowe, Geoff Gustafson, Gregory Harrison.

programme.title: Hailey Dean Mysteries: 2+2=Murder
programme.desc: Hailey attends her niece's school recital only to learn that the beloved music teacher has vanished. Hailey soon discovers several startling secrets amongst the staff. Stars Kellie Martin.

programme.title: Hailey Dean Mysteries: A Marriage Made for Murder
programme.desc: Hailey finds herself entangled in Atlanta's notorious "Black Widow" murder case and it will take all her personal resources to bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: God's Bomber
programme.desc: The 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia are rocked by a massive pipe bomb explosion. A woman is killed and hundreds injured. Subsequent bombs at an abortion clinic and a gay bar show a similar M.O., and increasing refinement. Police have no clue who is behind the bombings until they receive a letter signed by ‘The Army of God’, an anti-abortion, anti-gay, white supremacist group. When another abortion clinic is bombed in Birmingham, Alabama, a witness sees a suspicious man leaving the scene and gets his license number. Police are soon on the trail of Christian extremist Eric Rudolph, but it will take a five year manhunt through the rugged terrain of the Natahala National Forest before they can catch America’s Most Wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Calder Tyrant
programme.desc: A child serial killer terrorizes the city of Saskatoon; a high school student is tortured to death over the course of a weekend by a gang. programme.title: God's Bomber
programme.desc: The 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia are rocked by a massive pipe bomb explosion. A woman is killed and hundreds injured. Subsequent bombs at an abortion clinic and a gay bar show a similar M.O., and increasing refinement. Police have no clue who is behind the bombings until they receive a letter signed by ‘The Army of God’, an anti-abortion, anti-gay, white supremacist group. When another abortion clinic is bombed in Birmingham, Alabama, a witness sees a suspicious man leaving the scene and gets his license number. Police are soon on the trail of Christian extremist Eric Rudolph, but it will take a five year manhunt through the rugged terrain of the Natahala National Forest before they can catch America’s Most Wanted criminal.

programme.title: Forsaken
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

Police must uncover a twisted trail of clues that lead to a killer who claimed her death was accidental - though physical evidence suggests something far more sinister.

programme.title: Fallen Starlet
programme.desc: Rebecca Schaeffer is an aspiring actress who bursts onto the scene with a starring role in the hit sitcom My Sister Sam. However, fame comes with a price and just hours before her audition for Godfather III, she is found shot on her LA doorstep. Who could have wanted this rising star dead? The killer left few clues behind and investigators must unlock the secrets of a puzzling crime scene to catch him.

programme.title: Nashville Nightmare
programme.desc: Melissa Haferman is an aspiring country singer on the verge of a recording contract. She goes missing after traveling to Nashville to record a demo and is found strangled to death with her own rodeo belt. Evidence leads to a man who eliminated the rising star to boost his own twisted thirst for fame.

programme.title: Fatal Audition
programme.desc: Karin Schlegel beats hundreds to win the starring role in a feature film with an up-and-coming New York City director. Before the movie begins shooting, she gets another big gig - an opportunity to model for a national print ad. She goes to the shoot - and vanishes. When her body turns up nude on top of an apartment building, the police investigation reveals a psychologically twisted killer and a nightmare that shakes the Big Apple to its core.

programme.title: Knock Knock You're Dead
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. The number of victims is growing and all are attractive, successful young women -- women whose mainstream, “low risk” lifestyle should never put them on the radar of a killer. But this is the hardest kind of serial killer to catch -- impulsive, always changing his M.O. An unprecedented coalition of state and federal police agencies, including the FBI, will join forces to solve this disturbing, yet fascinating case. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.

programme.title: Forsaken
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Pyro
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: The Fifth Commandment
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. With a long list of suspects and millions of dollars on the line, investigators are suddenly thrust into a dangerous world of high stakes deception fueled by passion, greed and revenge. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal: The Crazy Annie Story

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Piece,' hosts Danielle and Shay dive into a lively discussion filled with personal stories and reflections. Filmed during an evening session, they explore topics such as the hosts' preference for nighttime energy, the nap debate, memorable college experiences, and the cultural differences in substance use. They also touch on the impact of natural disasters like California fires, the importance of healthy eating, and Shay's personal revelation about her dating life and the importance of shooting your shot. It's a candid conversation that offers a mix of humor, nostalgia, and genuine advice.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Nine: Fun Facts and True Friendship: How Well Do You Know Me?
programme.desc: Join Danielle and Shay in an engaging and hilarious episode of 'Pardon My Peace' as they dive into a series of personal questions in the game 'How Well Do You Know Me?'. Watch as they share fun facts about each other, discuss their pet peeves, dream jobs, favorite foods, and recall childhood memories. programme.title: Imagine PlayWorld

programme.title: Imagine PlayWorld

programme.desc: Picking, sorting, juicing and baking Dazzle Land's colorful Snoogleberries can be a lot of fun, if you follow the directions. It takes teamwork and an imaginative Dazzle to sort things out again.

programme.title: Episode 3: CHEARS FOR FEAR
programme.desc: In a Dazzle Land amusement park, Bommi and her friends confront different things that they fear, such as heights and darkness. All except Rumba, why?

programme.title: Episode 4: A TACO TALE
programme.desc: On Dazzle Land Beach Day, Taco borrows Remba's beautiful Snazzle Bedazzle Shell necklace. When he accidentally loses it, he doesn't immediately tell the truth, leading to difficult situations..

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Episode 9: TRY TRY AGAIN
programme.desc: Remba believes that she can learn to the play borzzlehorn just by listening to it. Yip believes that he can learn to jump rope just by watching Taco.

programme.title: Episode 10: A LITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
programme.desc: A magical dazzle kite draws pictures in the sky, alerting Bommi and friends to others in need. In a fun sequence of adventures, everyone realizes how friendships are made stronger

programme.title: Episode 11: A TAILING TALE
programme.desc: Razzle Dazzle Day celebrates the uniqueness of Dazzle Land with a Surprise Dazzle. But it only happens if all the friends are together at sunset ...

programme.title: Episode 12: THE BIG CLEAN
programme.desc: Unusual Clean-up Weather is heading the way of Bommi and Friends! After the falling soap bubbles, the rain and the drying wind machines, it's time to put everything away

programme.title: Episode 13: THE GREAT RACE
programme.desc: It's the great Fazzmobile Relay Race and Maya has promised Yip that he can drive one of the Fazzmobiles. However, she reconsiders and decides to drive it herself, breaking her promise to Yip.

programme.title: Who Am I Happy
programme.desc: When Mika enters 15-year-old Alicia life, she is confused by their appearance.

programme.title: Beat Beat Heart
programme.desc: A playful romanticist has been waiting for the love of her life to return – when suddenly her newly separated mother moves in.

programme.title: Black Panther – The Story of Emilie and Jacob
programme.desc: Siblings Emilie and Jacob cannot help feeling a deep love for each other. After being apart for many years, they meet in the mountains.

programme.title: Clumsy Little Acts of Tenderness
programme.desc: The Finnish short comedy by Miia Tervo portrays an anything but typical relationship between a loving father and his skeptical daughter.

programme.title: Shot In The Dark
programme.desc: An intimate portrait of three successful blind artists whose visual impairment has become the starting point for their visual explorations.

programme.title: Schmitke
programme.desc: What should have been a ordinary job in the Czech Ore Mountains, becomes a mysterious expedition for the aging engineer Julius Schmitke.

programme.title: Honey and Ashes
programme.desc: Naima, a doctor, Amina, a graduate, and Leila, a young student, are pursuing their individual routes to an independent life when their paths cross.

programme.title: Papa Gold
programme.desc: Denny lives in in the city, boozes and dances through the night, and sleeps with one girl after another.

programme.title: HomeSick
programme.desc: The ambitious cello student Jessica and her boyfriend recently moved in together. But soon dark clouds are gathering above the young couple.

programme.title: Frontalwatte
programme.desc: Frontalwatte is like running against a wall and falling softly. Franz, Adrian and Anastasia stumble through a world without consequences.

programme.title: Family Fever
programme.desc: A German Mumblecore tragicomedy set in a Brandenburg mansion. Three couples, six people, love, deceit, and the question: what's next?

programme.title: Away You Go
programme.desc: Compassionate mumblecore-style drama about a young woman's struggles with the expectations placed on her by her partner and friends.

programme.title: Kleptomami
programme.desc: A film about the absurdities of being a mom today.

programme.title: Minus One
programme.desc: Summer in Athens, and Elsa’s family isn’t the only one renting their apartment to tourists. At their "spare apartment" there’s little space for the young lady’s dreams.

programme.title: In Heaven's Meadow
programme.desc: After an assault, Maya tries to find her way back into life.

programme.title: Happiness Is a Warm Gun
programme.desc: Green Party icon Petra Kelly is shot in her sleep by her partner Gert Bastian, an ex-Federal Armed Forces general, before he kills himself.

programme.title: Everything Always All the Time
programme.desc: What happens when your girlfriend suddenly has a penis?

programme.title: Lost in the Living
programme.desc: A young Irish musician immerses himself into Berlin nightlife after a concert and loses more than just his friends in the process.

programme.title: Mann im Spagat- Pace, Cowboy, Pace
programme.desc: A delightfully absurd Berlin comedy about bicycle messengers, new age esoterica, and saving the world.
A young woman ventures into the deadly beauty of the Chernobyl exclusion zone to save her father from prison.

programme.title: 9 Lives
programme.desc: 9 LIVES portrays the fate of young people who decided at the age of 11, 12 or 13 to leave home and to live on the streets.

programme.title: Marseille
programme.desc: "German cinema can be this exciting: Angela Schanelec's fourth film MARSEILLE" (taz)

programme.title: Afternoon
programme.desc: On 3 summer afternoons, a family meets up a beautiful house in an upscale Berlin neighborhood. They come together but ultimately drift further apart.

programme.title: MansFeld
programme.desc: A magical film about the mysteries of childhood and an old custom: In the village of MANSFELD, the ritual banishment of the old takes place every year
Marc is a surfer and lives his life one day at a time. But after many strokes of fate, he dreams of turning back time, and starting all over again.

programme.title: In Your Arms
programme.desc: The poetic tale of a man with a neurological disorder and the enigmatic nurse persuaded to support him with assisted suicide.

programme.title: Name Me
programme.desc: An adeptly played debut in which a yearning for paternal affection plays out against a background of teenage sexual manipulation.

programme.title: The Postman's White Nights
programme.desc: Quiet drama about the Russian soul, corruption and the postman from Lake Kenozero in northern Russia.

programme.title: The Dreamed Path
programme.desc: After a vacation romance, Kenneth and Theres lose sight of each other. But fate brings them together again 30 years later.

programme.title: Gisela
programme.desc: Authentic, haphazard and unromantic, three residents of a high-rise housing estate search for love, friendship and sexuality.

programme.title: The Grass is Greener Everywhere Else
programme.desc: Either the grass is greener, or the houses are bigger, or the sun is warmer ... anywhere else is better.

programme.title: Junk Space Berlin
programme.desc: Welcome to the marginal deviation of reality. An inexplicable rift runs through the dystopian Berlin and four outsiders venture to find their friend.

programme.title: She Is a Good Boy
programme.desc: When Ava's father Gunter, a classic macho dude, shows up at her door, worlds collide.

programme.title: Forces
programme.desc: Under the crushing emotional burden of his terminally ill father and violent brother, 14-year-old Daniel seeks refuge with two outcasts.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: When a mother and her daughter take a vacation at the Baltic Sea, it quickly turns into a journey into the past that opens up old wounds.

programme.title: Youth Topia
programme.desc: In a world driven by algorithms, a group of "forever teenagers" rebel against the dictates of self-optimization.

programme.title: Burning Beds
programme.desc: Hamburg's housing shortage forces car inspector Gina and British pyromaniac Harry to move into the same apartment.

programme.title: Adam Ondra: Pushing the Limits

programme.title: Dr. Sebi's Daughter Talks National Holiday, Documentary, and Wellness
programme.desc: Kellie Bowman, daughter of the late Dr. Sebi, owner of Sebi’s Daughters LLC, and celebrity nurse, is a passionate advocate for holistic health practices that can truly transform lives. With a profound understanding of the mind-body connection passed down from her father, Kellie offers a unique blend of insights that can empower informed choices for holistic well-being. She's also working on a national holiday to honor her late father's pioneer work in the health and wellness sector and speaks on the Dr. Sebi documentary Nick Cannon is working on.

programme.title: Jay Jordan of Reform Alliance Explains Importance of Probation Reform
programme.desc: Jay Jordan, Reform Alliance’s new VP of Community Engagement, is shedding light on the nonprofit’s new C-Suite additions and the critical role they’ll play in driving its mission forward. He breaks down why Reform’s focus on probation and parole reform is so essential to criminal justice reform—and how having major celebrity support helps bring both attention and bipartisan momentum to the cause.

programme.title: Yvette Nicole Brown & Kym Whitley Sound Off On Trump & Defend Mayor Bass
programme.desc: Actresses Yvette Nicole Brown and Kym Whitley aren't biting their tongues when it comes to defending Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass from criticism over her response to the SoCal wildfires, blasting the Black celebs who performed at Trump's inauguration, and giving their two senses on what the next four years hold. The "Act Your Age" stars sit down with BLACK ENTERPRISE to share their spirited take on the current state of the country.

programme.title: Gabrielle Union Shares Kaavia's Inspiration In New PROUDLY Clothing Launch
programme.desc: Actress and entrepreneur Gabrielle Union is leading the expansion of her PROUDLY baby care line into babywear. In a conversation with Jeroslyn JoVonn on The Culture Shift, Union shares how her daughter Kaavia inspired the designs and opens up about how she and husband Dwyane Wade collaborate on family and business decisions.

programme.title: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" Director Explains Use of Satire
programme.desc: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" director and cast sits down with BLACK ENTERPRISE "The Culture Shift" to share how the satirical comedy tackles the “magical negro” trope popularized in American cinema and television throughout the 20th Century. Director Kobi Libii, lead actor Justice Smith, and supporting actress Nicole Byer explain the film's plot and it aims to inspire Black viewers to see the value in themselves.

programme.title: Lil Jon Manifests Abundance On New Guided Meditation Album
programme.desc: After 20 years of helping us turn up, Grammy award-winning rapper/producer Lil Jon is assisting us with turning down and tuning in to ourselves with his second guided meditation album "Manifest Abundance." The album coincides with his partnership with the wellness supplement brand Natural Vitality during Mental Health Awareness Month. Lil Jon sits down with Black Enterprise to share how he found the balance between partying for work and practicing mindfulness during his downtime. He also shares the perfect mantra to use throughout the day.

programme.title: Permission to Put Yourself First
programme.desc: The most accomplished women will tell you there’s no shame in asking for what you want. We’re sitting down with beloved actress and entrepreneur Tia Mowry to explore how to find success and happiness by making yourself priority No. 1. Remarks: Courtney Johnson, Regional Vice President, National Sales & Account Management; Co-Chair, Black Leadership Forum, Prudential Speaker: Tia Mowry, Founder & Owner, 4U by Tia Moderator: Tashara Parker, Emmy award-winning journalist; Social Justice Advocate

programme.title: Progress, Not Perfection Hosted by Eli Lilly & Company
programme.desc: It’s time to let go, once and for all, of the idea that we have to be perfect and instead learn to get out of our comfort zones, cultivate risk, and embrace failure. programme.title: Issa Rae WPS 2023

programme.title: Self-Reliance - How It Can Help You Get Farther Ahead
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Rundown with Ramon," media consultant Maha Abouelenein discusses her new book, "Seven Rules of Self-Reliance." In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Abouelenein shares insights from her career working with tech giants and high-profile individuals, offering practical advice for personal and professional growth. She emphasizes the importance of creating value, managing one's reputation, and adopting a long-term mindset. Abouelenein also shares personal experiences that shaped her approach to life and work, providing listeners with actionable strategies for success in today's fast-paced world.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Can Everyone Be a Millionaire? With This Mindset, Yes!
programme.desc: Money has a significant impact on our lives, and our relationship with it can shape our financial journey — for better or for worse. In an interview with Toyin Crandell, founder of Toyin Crandell Coaching, Ramon Ray unpacks her journey from financial apathy to business success, providing inspiration and insights for anyone looking to redefine their relationship with money and success. Crandell’s story is a testament to the power of a money mindset shift — one that led her from feeling indifference toward money to setting an ambitious financial goal and achieving it in just three years.

programme.desc: Natasha Rothwell is relishing ahead of the premiere of her new Hulu show "How To Die Alone." programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: Success is in Sight, Now What?
programme.desc: When bars and pubs across the world closed during the pandemic, so did their game nights. For Mark Walsh, it was a heart-stopping moment as British pub quizzes were his business. He immediately set to work reimagining this unique style of trivia entertainment by creating his Kwizzbit app. The growth has been so fast that his team has been working to redevelop the platform to be able to host up to 100,000 players at a time. But Marks been struggling to meet the demands.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

Damon later opened DD172, an art gallery and creative collective in New York City, in addition to founding Creative Control -- a digital media platform that explored the intersection of music, art and culture. His portfolio of ventures also includes a spirits company, another clothing company and Dame Dash Studios. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.title: Super Coffee: How to Scale Culture in a Family Business
programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. He dropped out of college to go full-time on his side-hustle and now, together with his two brothers runs the bottled beverage brand out of Austin, Texas. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

programme.title: Dinner and Apps
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Seattle, Washington to talk with chef Edouardo Jordan, creator of Salare, a farm to table restaurant with rave reviews. Then they head to Ann Arbor, Michigan to talk to Skye Durrant and Brandon Bertrang founders of LawnGuru, an online lawn service and mobile app.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.desc: Learning how to handle anxiety about the future is an essential step toward achieving your goals. When faced with uncertainty, we tend to fear the future. But it doesnt have to be this way. In this episode, we introduce a few strategies to stop letting fear get in your way. Learn effective methods for how to handle anxiety by interrupting your thoughts, turning your attention toward those thoughts, and questioning whether your fear of the future is genuinely valid.

programme.desc: With more and more of the workforce becoming freelance, we've got lots of people getting into this fantastic way of living, but we need to learn how to get started. Freelancing takes a set of skills and a mindset that many beginners don't quite understand fully, so it's essential to show you all the ropes so you can get started and take your business to the next level.

programme.desc: Rich Antoniello is the co-founder and CEO of Complex Media. Complex is the intersection between all things pop culture from hip hop to sneakers and dominates the male market of 18-24 with 55m monthly viewers. Through the companies latest annual conference, ComplexCon, they're now disrupting traditional retail by providing a fully immersive experience for event goers. They've been disrupting media for decades and caught the attention of Verizon and Hearst in 2016, who jointly acquired 50% of the company for reportedly well over $250m.

programme.desc: MICK used music to propel his career. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.
