Find out which startup moves to the semi-finals!

programme.title: Did Marc Just Get Career Envy?
programme.desc: James is an adventurer in both life and business. But when your career is breaking world records how do you turn that into a sustainable business? He thinks he found his answer when he created his wilderness team building program My Adventure Group and hes getting rave reviews. The trouble is, hes just not getting enough customers.

programme.title: Why Most Founders Can't Grow Past 25 Employees
programme.desc: Weebly co-founder David Rusenko reflects on scaling the company, confronting his own leadership challenges and the dinner with Richard Branson that changed his approach.

programme.title: Cheesy Effects
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Bandon, Oregon to talk with Greg Drobot and Daniel Graham, the co-founders of Facerock Creamery, an artisan cheese factory and retail store. Then they head to Poway, California to talk with Brea Joseph, the owner of KBZ FX, a special FX make-up studio.

programme.title: What Is Mindfulness? Start Living In The Present Moment And Do More With A Mindful Hustle
programme.desc: Being mindful and living in the present moment will allow you to keep up with the daily hustle without becoming too overwhelmed. Mindful hustle is the idea that you can be productive while pausing your mind throughout the day to stay present. By cultivating mindfulness throughout your day, you can avoid much of the stress that builds over the day.

programme.title: Setting Your Goals - Here's How To Achieve The Goals You Set
programme.desc: So many of us set big (or small) goals in life, but the reality is that so few of us hit those goals we set. If you want to achieve and surpass those goals, you need a reliable process to get you there. In this video, I will teach you exactly how to set goals in a way that pushes you toward them.

programme.title: Kym Gold Explains How She Started and Sold True Religion for $835M
programme.desc: Kym Gold is the co-creator of True Religion Brand Jeans; author of the business book Gold Standard: How to Rock the World and Run an Empire; and producer for projects with a social conscience, including the documentary SLAG: Served Like a Girl. Kyms unwavering drive has helped her achieve success as a designer and entrepreneur. She shares tips about life, business and selling her company for $800m+.

programme.title: Redefining Modern Art In The Graffiti Generation
programme.desc: Timmy Sneaks is a modern creative and graffiti artist from Boston. His unique style and brand has garnered interest from the highest level brand and influencers like Kevin Hart, Scott Disick and Robinson Cano. In this episode of Action & Ambition with Andrew Medal, Timmy discusses his beginnings and how he turned his passion for art into a thriving business, keys to luxury branding, and the vision for his empire.

programme.desc: Meet Flytrex & their intelligent drone delivery system for any business. Order your drone package, and be delivered by drone in no time. JC visits WeWork Tel Aviv to find an exciting start-up that creates a TV scanner app to hear any audio on your phone from a TV in an airport, or train station. We also talk to Ruth about her impactful venture to help to monitor and protect us from old age.

programme.desc: The Season Finale discovers five innovators who are making headway and, ranging from futuristic scanners that can detect the quality & makeup of fruit, meat, pills & other substances, to Autonomous Robot Window Washers that can scale tall buildings & Mind Controlled Games to assist with ADHD. Israel is a hotbed for innovation & houses more start-ups per capita than anywhere else.

(carbon-free smart aerial mobility), E-panipurii kartz (touchless operation for Panipuri vendors), and Wow Mom (healthy fast food). programme.title: Paris

Tension builds as judges unveil which Paris startup advances to the semi-finals!

programme.title: From Psychedelics to a $28m+ Business Empire to New York Times Best Seller
programme.desc: Aubrey Marcus is the founder and CEO of Onnit, a lifestyle brand based on a holistic health philosophy he calls Total Human Optimization. Since its founding, Onnit has become an Inc. 500 company and industry leader with over 250 products ranging from peak performance supplements to foods, fitness equipment, and apparel. Inspired by his lifelong experience as a multisport athlete as well as his background in ancient philosophy his goal was to create a company that empowered customers to achieve their fullest human potential. With the launch of the firms flagship supplement Alpha BRAIN in 2011, Onnit was born.

programme.desc: Frederick is the CEO and founder of Pigeonly, a low-cost communication and financial services platform that makes it easy for people to support an incarcerated loved one. Hutson leads a growing team of over 20 people from their Las Vegas headquarters and has raised over $5MM in funding from investors.

Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Early Grave

Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: El Resurgir de la Momia
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta a una momia ancestral. Tras quedar atrapados en un bucle temporal, la única forma de escapar es derrotarla. A medida que aumenta el número de cadáveres, parece que la Momia debe recolectar las almas de quienes la despertaron para poder caminar sobre la tierra, para siempre...

programme.title: Jack y Jill 3
programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Portal de Monstruos de H.P. Lovecraft
programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: Jack y Jill
programme.desc: Una adaptación terrorífica de la canción infantil Jack y Jill. Un grupo de amigos afligidos por una pérdida reciente se reúnen sólo para descubrir que están siendo perseguidos por Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Krampus 2: El Diablo Regresa
programme.desc: Cinco años después del asesinato de su esposa y la desaparición de su hija, el ex policía Jeremy Duffin es traído de vuelta para ayudar en la caza de un monstruo de Yuletide que castiga a los niños que han sido «traviesos». A medida que el monstruo se vuelve más errático e impredecible, Jeremy descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de su hija y el destino que le ha deparado una fuente improbable. ¿Podrá Jeremy acabar finalmente con la pesadilla del monstruo navideño que ha aterrorizado a este pueblo durante años?

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: ¿Qué ocurre cuando estalla una epidemia y no se sabe nada? Puede ocurrir cualquier cosa. Poco a poco, los residentes se dan cuenta de que todos morirán a menos que se unan...

programme.title: Poltergeist Americano
programme.desc: Horribles visiones atormentan a Taryn cuando ella, su hermano y sus compañeros de universidad se mudan a una vieja e infame casa. Entonces, sus sangrientas alucinaciones se vuelven demasiado reales...

programme.title: Isla de las Muñecas
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas va a la legendaria Isla de las Muñecas para conocer la verdad mortal...

programme.title: El Mal Interior
programme.desc: Un chico solitario y mentalmente discapacitado se hace amigo de su reflejo en un espejo antiguo. Esta criatura demoníaca le ordena que se lance a una matanza asesina de las personas que más quiere...

programme.title: Ana
programme.desc: Dos hombres roban una muñeca de un museo que, sin saberlo, abre una puerta al Infierno...

programme.title: Alfredo
programme.desc: Brendan Cobbs, un famoso novelista, es enviado a una remota cabaña de la Inglaterra rural en busca de inspiración para su próxima novela. Cree haber encontrado su próximo tema cuando se encuentra con Alfred, un muñeco del tamaño de un niño que puede cobrar vida. Pero surgen consecuencias mortales cuando Brendan se da cuenta de que Alfred tiene intención de matar.

programme.title: Hotel Dinosaurio
programme.desc: Sienna está desesperada por ganar un gran premio en metálico en un concurso secreto clandestino, pero los dinosaurios comienzan a cazarla para entretenimiento de los ricos y adinerados. ¿Podrá ser la última en sobrevivir a la horrible noche para ganar el premio?

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: Un reportero investiga un misterioso accidente y descubre algo más que un objeto, sino una enorme conspiración gubernamental. Inspirada en los hechos reales del 9 de diciembre de 1965 y en uno de los incidentes OVNI más misteriosos de Estados Unidos...

programme.title: El Culto de Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolescentes con problemas y su maestra deben luchar por sobrevivir después de descubrir que una secta ha devuelto la vida a Humpty Dumpty, un muñeco asesino, y lo ha liberado en el campamento en el que se encuentran...

programme.title: El Bosque del Diablo
programme.desc: Rachel y su equipo de cineastas viajan a Transilvania, Rumania, para documentar los fenómenos paranormales en el bosque de Hoia-Baciu...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Gators, Grizzlies & Swamp Hunting After Dark - S6E4
programme.desc: Todd Bonura, Tom Stevenson, and KJ share gator hunting close calls, a grizzly bear encounter at dark, and why swamp hunting at night is a different kind of scary on Gun Talk Hunt.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Lightning, Wolves & Drug Busts in the Dark -S6E5
programme.desc: KJ, game warden Jeremy King, and land agent Thomas Allen share their scariest hunting moments — lightning strikes, a midnight drug bust, and wolves in northern Minnesota.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Backyard Cookout Intruder - S3E7
programme.desc: TJ defends friends and family at a cookout from a knife-wielding robber. Will a hostage deter him from using deadly force?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Assault at the Drug Clinic - S3E8
programme.desc: Christine, a nurse, is leaving work when an armed intruder demands drugs. Does she have the wherewithal to draw from her purse to intervene when the intruder attacks?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Parking Lot Stabbing - S3E9
programme.desc: Jessica witnesses a stabbing in parking lot and intervenes to help the victim. Will she use verbal commands and avoid closing gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gun Fight at the Party - S3E10
programme.desc: Colin is at a party when a guest gets unruly with some female guests. Will he survive the encounter, and how will he deal with multiple assailants?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Bar Fight Escalation - S3E11
programme.desc: Gary witnesses an argument escalating in bar. Does he draw too soon trying to game the game? Will he perform when a distraction causes him to react more slowly?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Pool Table Gunfight - S3E12
programme.desc: Matte witnesses an argument escalating around a pool table at the bar. What is available for cover when the fight threatens to turn deadly? Will he close the gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - ATM Armed Robbery - S3E13
programme.desc: Matt intervenes in ATM robbery. Will his experience lead him to create distance, verbal commands and avoid closing gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Workplace Shooting - S3E14
programme.desc: Doug attends workplace meeting when an armed intruder bursts in and starts shooting. Does he use cover, verbal commands and know how to prioritize threats?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Home Burglary Safe Access - S4E1
programme.desc: Mike defends his home from an intruder. He uses a laser, cover, and family coordination. Lessons: quick safe drills, clear commands, doorway advantage.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Classroom Active Shooter Response - S4E2
programme.desc: David faces an active shooter bursting into the classroom. He learns to announce his good guy status, move people to safety, use doorway cover, and pie corners.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gas Station Armed Confrontation - S4E3
programme.desc: Tim witnesses an agitated customer escalating at gas station, he draws when a gun appears. He learns to de-escalate early, contact shots, and how to articulate to 911.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Property Inspection Robbery - S4E4
programme.desc: Lyle inspects a vacant house with realtor when armed robbers attack. He learns one-handed gun manipulation, punch-style one-handed shooting and chambering a round for readiness.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Store Domestic Dispute Shooting - S4E5
programme.desc: Nathan, an EMT, witnesses an agitated man escalate a domestic dispute in a store, attacking with bat. He learns to create distance early, verbal commands and to intervene on deadly force.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Apartment Intruder Response - S4E6
programme.desc: Roseanne defends her apartment from an intruder after being alerted by an open door. She learns to stage guns, instinctive laser aim and use clear commands.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gas Station Domestic Escalation - S4E7
programme.desc: Raven defends a gas station from a bat-wielding attacker in a domestic dispute. She learns to get distance, verbal commands and when to intervene.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Auto Shop Armed Robbery - S5E1
programme.desc: Dispute at an auto shop escalates into armed threats. Ben defends his friend and uses cover to close the distance. Preparation beats reaction.

programme.title: First Person Defender - ATM Double Armed Robbery - S5E2
programme.desc: Brian defends against two armed ATM robbers. He learns to counter flank, hold cover, and articulate perceived danger.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Driveway Car Break-In Defense - S5E3
programme.desc: Carson defends against a driveway car break-in. He learns evasion, vehicle cover, malfunction drills, and why distance beats draw.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Deer Stand Standoff - S5E4
programme.desc: Doug faces trespasser in deer stand. Will he walk away, report theft or fight over a rifle. Action beats reaction; discretion saves lives.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Home Invasion Baseball Bat Threat - S5E5
programme.desc: Graham defends against a bat-wielding intruder in his home. Fast draws, evasion, deflection, and why not to chase are covered. Decisiveness is key in close quarters.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Camping Armed Trespasser - S5E6
programme.desc: Ian defends his girlfriend and camp from demanding intruders. His quick draw on furtive movement, distance, and distractions are key.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Office Shooting Response - S5E7
programme.desc: Joey hears chaos and shooting from a back room at work. Will he confront an armed suspect and neutralize the threat? He learns gun security and to prioritize the wounded.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Backyard Fishing Hook Ambush - S5E8
programme.desc: Jon aids "injured" fisherman on his backyard deck. The ruse leads to an armed robbery with his friend as a hostage. Training includes deflection and garment clearing under pressure.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Music Store Armed Robbery - S5E9
programme.desc: Kyle faces a shoplifter turned armed robber in a music store. He accesses a weapon from a quick safe to confront the threat. De-escalation and locked doors are covered in the training.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Late Night Parking Lot Assault - S5E10
programme.desc: Lisa faces a late-night parking lot attacker while leaving fitness class. Will she draw from her purse in time and fight back or will she be a silent victim?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Parking Garage Carjacking Threat - S5E11
programme.desc: Mallory faces an aggressive man in dark parking garage demanding a ride. She learns to swing wide for better visibility and to take decisive action under stress.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Garage Argument Gunfight - S5E12
programme.desc: Scott leaps into action when a fight between two unknown men turns deadly. Will his decision making hold up to scrutiny?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Workplace Active Shooter Chaos - S6E1
programme.desc: Ryan and Billy face a sudden workplace shooting while picking up checks. They navigate chaos, learn buddy tactics, threshold assessment, and why vehicles fail as cover against rifles.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Ride Share Kidnap Escape - S6E2
programme.desc: Caleb faces a suspicious ride share driver detour and alley threat. He exits safely, maintains distance, calls 911, and uses retention techniques in close fights. Mind over gun wins.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Armed Robbery Gunfight - S6E3
programme.desc: Christian and Amanda face an armed robber while shopping. Training covers medical response, low ready draw, and when not to escalate.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Office Meeting Ambush - S6E4
programme.desc: Johanna faces a furious coworker turning violent in a meeting. She reacts fast, engages, but learns key lessons on maneuvering to the door, dominating angles, and mastering sight alignment under stress.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Convenience Store Carjacking - S6E5
programme.desc: Joseph fights carjacking from his car at a store. Low draw and windshield shots with aim adjustment are covered as well as Ashley’s situational awareness.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Parking Lot Carjacking Fight - S6E6
programme.desc: Kelly and Leslie face an armed carjacking in parking lot. Kelly fights for gun control with an underhook escape. Leslie learns angle shifts to avoid shoot-throughs.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Road Rage Stoplight Attack - S6E7
programme.desc: Road rage rear-end turns to a gun threat. Larry defends, Rachel exits to engine block cover. Lessons learned; get off X, use the car as cover, communicate as a team.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Home Invasion Child Defense - S6E8
programme.desc: Luke and Nadine face home invasion with young son at risk. Luke engages dynamically; Nadine protects the child. Training covers nightstand prep, doorway domination, movement as a team, and rifle advantages.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Grocery Ambush Entangled Fight - S6E9
programme.desc: Sean and Jordyn face an armed ambush unloading groceries. Sean grapples; Jordan aggressively intervenes with contact shots. They learn to pre-plan roles & mental "what-ifs."

programme.title: First Person Defender - Rest Stop Domestic Intervention - S6E10
programme.desc: Mike intervenes in restroom domestic assault after calling 911. He learns to assess fully, pie door, and offset angles to prevent shoot-throughs.

programme.title: First Person Defender - The Trainer’s Corner - S6E11
programme.desc: Training episode with Chris & Michelle Cerino at Boondocks Academy. Covers committed trigger, action vs reaction, lowlight tactics, movement & cover, and mindset in fast-paced scenarios.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Hostage in the Park Restroom - S7E1
programme.desc: Bill’s wife is grabbed at knifepoint in a dark park restroom. Can he make the lifesaving precision shot?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Domestic Dispute Turns Deadly - S7E2
programme.desc: Boyd watches a couple argue violently outside the restaurant. When the man pulls a gun on his girlfriend, can Boyd stop him?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Retail Store Active Shooter - S7E3
programme.desc: Candice shops with her husband when a gunman opens fire. Can she use racks for cover and stop the massacre?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Grocery Store Armed Robbery - S7E4
programme.desc: Chad shops for toilet paper when armed robbers storm the store. Can he draw and stop them from the middle of the aisle?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Restaurant Domestic Dispute Escalates - S7E5
programme.desc: Dave watches a couple argue violently in a restaurant. When the man pulls a gun on his girlfriend, can Dave stop him?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Alley Gunpoint Encounter - S7E6
programme.desc: John takes out the trash and walks into a dark alley confrontation. Can he escape the gunpoint chaos alive?

programme.desc: Dos jóvenes investigadores de fenómenos paranormales reciben el reto de pasar un fin de semana en una casa donde habitan seres malignos. programme.title: Mi Pequeña Pesadilla
programme.desc: Después de la terrible experiencia y la pérdida de sus amigos, Heather se ve obligada a regresar al Hotel Fear donde Travis se prepara para sus próximas víctimas.

programme.title: Vecinos del Terror
programme.desc: Por accidente se les dispara un arma con el impacto matan al cuñado quien después regresa de ultratumba a cobrar venganza y ni la policía se escapa de la venganza de ultratumba

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: El Director (Las Siete Madres de Edipo)
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes estudiantes de actuación siguiendo sus sueños se embarcan en un proyecto para filmar una película de terror que no resulta ser lo que esperaban.

programme.title: La Mujer que Hablaba con Los Muertos
programme.desc: Es un film de Terror. Cuando Elena Castaño era una niña, tenía un don: era capaz de comunicarse con los espíritus de los muertos. pero esa capacidad desapareció al crecer.

programme.title: El Cóndor En Nueva York
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante de Nueva York, llamado Damián, ha creado una nueva droga con efectos impactantes.

programme.title: Catemaco: Magia y Misterio
programme.desc: Una familia normal va de vacaciones a Catemaco, Michoacan un pueblo famoso y pintoresco en Mexico. Todo marcha bien hasta que son atacados por criminales, el padre sobrevive, y con ayuda del brujo mayor del pueblo cobra venganza.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: El Sonido de los Tulipanes
programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas.

programme.title: 48 Horas de Terror
programme.desc: Mateo un escritor citadino adquiere una casa de campo en donde planea vivir con su esposa y escribir en la tranquilidad del campo, pero no tomo en cuenta las trágicas noticias de los acontecimientos de canibalismo que ocurrieron a manos de sus vecinos quienes solo buscan sacias su hambre.

programme.title: Terror En La Montaña
programme.desc: Un soldado regresa a su país tras participar en la Guerra de las Malvinas y descubre que su esposa lo engaña con un alto político.

programme.title: La Araña Vampiro
programme.desc: Jerónimo tiene 20 años y está medicado con psicofármacos. Su padre piensa que unos días en un entorno natural pueden curarlo y decide llevarlo a una casa perdida en la montaña.

programme.title: Beber de tu Sangre
programme.desc: Una vampira se enamora de un hombre que conoció en un bar. Un vampiro invita a una mujer embarazada y a sus amigos a ver su obra de teatro. Estos dos vampiros son marido y mujer. Pero Ala ni y Gabriel son una pareja de vampiros aburridos de su larga vida en pareja. Ella decide tener un hijo, pero él no lo desea. Los problemas empiezan cuando Ala ni conoce y se enamora de Javier, pero no sabe que está casado con Lizvet y mucho menos que va a tener un hijo con ella.

programme.title: Escape En Vivo
programme.desc: Un investigador paranormal descubre una tierra de nadie infernal en un remoto y olvidado paisaje desértico donde payasos malvados esperan en un purgatorio sobrenatural para enfrentar su destino como venganza por sus malas acciones.

programme.title: Terror En La Sangre
programme.desc: Unas amigas que van a una fiesta que no existe y reciben un invitado sobrenatural.

programme.title: Gritos del Monday
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de Ingeniería Ambiental realizan un trabajo en la Reserva Ecológica de los Saltos del Monday, conocido por su rica fauna y su rica historia.

programme.title: Sanatorio
programme.desc: Rachel y Ryan son dos influencers populares que harán cualquier cosa para conseguir algunos Me gusta más y ganar el próximo desafío virtual.

programme.title: La Peste (Renaceremos de Nuestras Cenizas)
programme.desc: En un pueblito en donde reinaba la paz y tranquilidad un día inesperado sin saber cómo ni de donde cayó “La Peste” hundiendo a sus habitantes en la desolación y en la desesperanza, pero en medio de esa oscuridad surgirá un pequeño grupo de personas que ayudará a combatirla y a detenerla para siempre.

programme.title: Insignis
programme.desc: La vida de Jorge y Felipe, dos jóvenes amigos, da un vuelco del día que encuentran un cráneo enterrado en el jardín de uno de ellos.

programme.title: Call TV
programme.desc: Lucía, una actriz en decadencia, acepta presentar un programa nocturno de preguntas tontas. Sin darse cuenta de que se ha metido en un gran lío que le hará pasar la peor noche de su vida

programme.title: El Ultimo Fin de Semana
programme.desc: Diana quiere celebrar su próximo ascenso. Invita a la casa de su abuela a sus compañeros de trabajo, para pasar el fin de semana “perfecto”.

programme.title: Tu Cabeza en un Plato
programme.desc: Jóvenes viajeros calientes son marginados por una carretera bloqueada por árboles caídos y se detienen a pasar la noche en la mansión del sexy Sebastian.

programme.title: El Regreso De La Llorona
programme.desc: Una familia de Texas se muda a su nuevo hogar cuando es terrorisado por el famoso espíritu de la llorona, causando desgracias y muertes

programme.title: Predicción Fatal
programme.desc: Una lectura de tarot parece señalar a Manuel como el que causará la muerte de Acrisio, un político sin escrúpulos que es el padre de Danna, la novia de este joven.

programme.title: El Testigo Del Diablo
programme.desc: Cuando una seductora reina vampira decide que es hora de sentar cabeza, limita su búsqueda a cinco candidatos desprevenidos y los atrae a su mansión.

programme.title: El Beso Inmortal: La Reina De La Noche
programme.desc: Las vacaciones italianas de dos universitarias chocan con un antiguo ritual. Pero a veces los rezos se convierten en cazadores.

programme.title: La Leyenda De La Deseada
programme.desc: Recién llegada a Villaldama, Lizzy, apodada "La Deseada" por su belleza, se enamora de Fernando, un joven humilde.

programme.title: La Guarida De Los Payasos Asesinos
programme.desc: Dos policías investigan un espeluznante refugio vacío para personas sin hogar con un laberinto interminable de espacios y son atacados por zombis.

programme.title: 1962 La Masacre de Hallowen
programme.desc: En 1969, el FBI encontró una máscara que perteneció al asesino en serie que mató a 7 personas durante una fiesta de disfraces la noche de Halloween de 1972.

programme.title: En Un Lugar De La Mancha
programme.desc: En una pequeña localidad de La Mancha, Isabel y Silvia, cansadas de esconder su pasión, deciden marcharse un fin de semana a la casa rural que alquila el sacerdote de un pueblo cercano. Pronto lamentarán su decisión.

programme.title: El Expediente Belchite
programme.desc: El expediente Belchite no es solamente una historia de miedo; como toda narración que nos habla de una trascendencia más allá de vida terrena, la película plantea interrogantes sobre la finitud, o no, de eso que algunos llaman alma.

programme.title: Después Del Azul
programme.desc: Fausto se electrocuta y queda en coma, sobrevive con la realidad alterada, escucha a la soledad y ve varias mujeres que le representan la muerte.

programme.title: La Llaman Cazadora de Cabezas

programme.title: Lucero

programme.title: Creative Crochet Corner presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Creative Crochet Corner is an online video streaming service all about learning how to crochet! Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: National Quilting Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to quilt step by step with National Quilting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Design Alternatives
programme.desc: Upend traditional designs for a fresh look. Contemporary quilt designer Jacquie Gering manipulates the traditional quilting grid to make high-impact designs. Avid quilter Katie Burford shares how to start a modern quilt guild. Engineer and quilter Latifah Saafir creates bold designs with bias tape appliquÃ© on the surface of quilts.

programme.title: Modern Southwestern-Style Quilt
programme.desc: Angela creates a modern Southwestern-style quilt that's the perfect size to use as a blanket for summer picnics in the park.

programme.title: Bonus: Tips for Picking Quilt Designs
programme.desc: Angela shares her tips for choosing quick and impactful quilting designs for your pieced creations.

programme.title: Weave it Be
programme.desc: This week's woven lattice quilt might look intricate, but it's actually perfect for beginners!

programme.title: When the Wind Blows
programme.desc: When the wind blows and the rain falls, stay warm and dry. Sewing educator Joanne Banko uses cozy polar fleece to sew a fashionable ruana with embroidered details, inspired by those worn in the mountains of South America. Designer and blogger Alex Woodbury shows how to sew and finish specially-coated fabric to make a super-cute raincoat to keep you dry and on-trend.

programme.title: Make It Sparkle
programme.desc: Create your color story, then change it. With special wire-shaping techniques, author and crystal superfan Diane Whiting creates strands of beads and crystals that are interchangeable. In the Beading Lesson, Katie creates leather and bead bracelets that can be stacked or worn alone.

programme.title: Episode 1: Cards
programme.desc: Make your own special occasion with a unique card. First, Jenn Mason creates a photo card. Next, May Flaum uses a stamped image for her card design. Host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer interviews Kazan Clark. Then, Julie shows how to create a card background using photo corners. Last, Julie creates a card with a house shaped cut out.

programme.title: Episode 2: Around the House
programme.desc: Surround yourself with art in every part of your home. Julie Fei Fan Balzer begins with a frame that highlights our favorite things. Next up Jodi Ohl, creates a series called happy shacks; make your home your happy place. Then meet Ardith Goodwin for a house drawing using a common household material -- tar paper for roofing. Finally, Candie Cooper makes a mobile for any room creating a sense of balance and calm.

programme.title: Cook & Create
programme.desc: Welcome to CraftsyTV's Cook & Create, where delectable delights meet crafty creators.

programme.title: Flower Power Kids Quilt
programme.desc: It seems like only yesterday that Angela was stitching a baby quilt for her youngest daughter. Tonight, she's making a flower quilt for her daughter's new big girl bed. Power to the flower!

programme.title: Bonus: How to Pick Threads for Colorful Quilts
programme.desc: Stuck on which thread color to choose? You're not alone! This a common quilter's question, and Angela is here to give you some handy tips to pick thread colors for your quilts. Find out how to match thread colors to fabric so the quilting is nice and visible, while still blending in. Happy Quilting!

programme.title: Snail’s Trail Quilt
programme.desc: Have you ever worked on a quilt that seemed intimidating, but wasn't that bad once you got into it? Watch as Angela checks this snazzy Snail's Trail quilt from her quilting bucket list.

programme.title: Stress Relieving Half-Square Triangle Quilt
programme.desc: Ready to find your center? Tonight, Angela becomes one with the piecing as she makes a stress-relieving half-square triangle quilt.

programme.title: Colorful Geometric Quilt
programme.desc: Are you a "slow and steady" quilter or more of a "forget perfect, finish fast" quilter like Angela? Tonight, she uses templates and block piecing with LOTS of triangles to create an out-of-this-world ombré quilt. Plus, she shares some handy tips for quilting with rulers.

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: Cook & Create

Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: Cuddle Up
programme.desc: There’s a slight chill in the air and it’s time to cuddle up with cozy fabrics. Joanne Banko is first with a cozy, comfy baby blanket and her tried and true method for making satin binding. Then, make the perfect hooded cape with Emily Thompson; in fleece or terry it’s great to warm up in the evening or after the pool. Finally, it’s time to add the sleeves to the raincoat with Angela Wolf.

programme.title: Provisional Cast-On, Cable Cast-On & Split Neckline
programme.desc: Since when do knitters use crochet hooks? Find out how to work the provisional cast-on, cable cast-on, and more during the first Novel-T check in!

programme.title: T-Shirt Finishing Tips: Hems, Necklines + Weaving in Ends
programme.desc: So you’ve finished knitting your Novel-T, now what? Tune in to see how to weave in the ends when working with cotton yarn. Hint: this method involves fabric glue.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 4 - Charlotte Dujardin
programme.desc: Charlotte Dujardin is a british dressage rider, equestrian and writer. She is probably the most successful British dressage rider in history, holder of three Dressage world records and winning major titles in international competitions with only 35 years. She is the Olympic dressage champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016. In this episode, we find out what drives her towards success.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the latest season of Horse Academy Pro. We welcome our new students: Martina, Lucrezia, Magdalena, Julia, Dea, Carlota and Zoe to the equestrian facilities, and they start getting ready to warm up and receive training from Bruno Chimirri as well as from our trainer, Diego. Find out how their first day to become PROs goes on Horse Academy Pro!

programme.title: The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Moscow Polo Club vs Hamburger Polo Club
programme.desc: In order to advance to the following rounds, Moscow Polo Club will have to face Hamburger Polo Club in this first stage of the Polo Rider Cup 2021. With a 10/12 goals handicap and 5 chukkers, competition between the strongest polo teams in the world is on at the Polo Club de Chantilly. Enjoy the match between Moscow Polo Club and Hamburger Polo Club.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Polo Club de Chantilly vs Polo Club Düsseldorf
programme.desc: Welcome to the Polo Rider Cup. The ultimate polo club competition has arrived to the Polo Club of Chantilly facilities. This time, it is the turn of the hosts, Polo Club de Chantilly, to face the Polo Club Düsseldorf. Who will be victorious at the start of the competition?

Despite never thinking she would have a career with horses, now she is an extremely successful rider.

programme.title: The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

Sunshine Tour - Episode 6 - GP Suzuki

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 3 - Grit, Guts, and Game-Changers
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation with The Big Reveal! Join Sheriff Mark Lamb and MMA legend Ken Shamrock as they explore groundbreaking American companies revolutionizing their industries. From elite camo designed through deer vision science to lightweight titanium firearm suppressors and EMF-neutralizing tech for peak performance—each story uncovers passion, ingenuity, and grit. Discover what’s shaping America’s entrepreneurial spirit. It’s not just business. It’s The Big Reveal.

programme.title: Special Edition - Aires Tech: The Invisible Shield
programme.desc: Sheriff Mark Lamb (Surviving Mann) and UFC Hall of Famer Ken Shamrock (Surviving Mann) uncover a breakthrough changing how we live in a world full of invisible forces. Join them as Aires Tech reveals the science behind a revolutionary technology built to protect the human body from electromagnetic stress—empowering performance in a wired world.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 5 - Special Edition - Aires Tech: The Frequency of Wellness
programme.desc: From the ocean to the lab, The Big Reveal dives deeper into the hidden impact of electromagnetic pollution. Discover how Aires Tech is helping people, animals, and even bees thrive—unlocking the secrets to balance, vitality, and true wellness in our connected age.

programme.title: Special Edition - Air Tractor: Built for the Sky
programme.desc: Take flight with The Big Reveal as Don Mann (Surviving Mann), Sheriff Mark Lamb (Surviving Mann), and Laura Zaspel (Farm Hero) visit Air Tractor—America’s iconic maker of crop dusters, firefighting, and military aircraft. Witness the power, precision, and pride behind the company proving that American craftsmanship still soars.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 7 - Special Edition - Air Tractor: Inside The Flying Office
programme.desc: Laura Zaspel (Farm Hero) takes you inside the cockpit for a high-flying look at the future of farming. From cutting-edge aerial applications to next-gen science and sustainability, Air Tractor’s technology is redefining how we grow from the ground up.

programme.title: Tools That Change the Outcome
programme.desc: This episode of The Big Reveal showcases high-performance tools and innovations built for critical moments—from Jersey Tactical’s life-saving breaching device and Green Light’s lightning-fast handgun sights to Henry Repeating Arms’ modern lever-action rifle and Truefin’s customizable scuba fins, each designed to deliver precision, reliability, and results when it matters most.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 9 - Unlocking Better Brain Health
programme.desc: Lesley Visser joins nutritionist Mike Roussell and NFL Hall of Famer Mike Singletary to explore Neutein, cognitive-health research and why brain wellness has become personal for many users.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 4 - Forged in Freedom, Built in America
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Shots, Tim Harmsen heads to the heart of American gun craftsmanship with an exclusive, behind-the-scenes tour of Palmetto State Armory, where freedom is literally built on the production floor. From the anodizing line to live assembly, Tim witnesses American ingenuity in action as a rifle comes to life before his eyes. With the epic 10,000-Round Challenge complete, it’s time for some serious maintenance. The crew at SEAL 1 steps in with their cutting-edge nanotechnology to give the battle-worn BCM AK the deep clean it deserves. Once the guns are gleaming, it’s time to send rounds downrange. Teaming up with top firearms influencer Sootch, Tim takes aim at a new challenge, including a 1,000-yard Wild Shot that pushes precision, patience, and performance to the limit.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 5 - Microns, Myths, and Machine Guns
programme.desc: This episode of Wildshots kicks off in South Carolina, where Tim Harmsen goes behind the scenes at Jacob Grey Firearms for an inside look at precision craftsmanship in action. Known for their stunning 2011 pistols—true works of art—Jacob Grey takes perfection to the micron. From raw metal to “The Hex,” Tim witnesses how engineering meets artistry to create one of America’s most elite handguns.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 3 - Welcome the Pain
programme.desc: Back by unpopular demand, the infamous “Blah Line” returns—and it’s more brutal than ever. The contestants kick off the day with a hellish PT session that leaves bodies broken and spirits tested. Things only get rougher from there with a punishing stealth crawl over jagged rocks, grinding them down before they face Ken Shamrock’s infamous Lion’s Den training—a relentless gauntlet of pain, grit, and raw endurance. As Don Mann continues to forge a battle-ready team, the squad is thrown into breaching drills designed for high-stakes mission execution. It’s chaos, it’s calculated, and it separates the contenders from the pretenders. In the heat of the action, two standouts emerge from the ranks—earning the coveted role of designated breachers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 1 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The best of the best are back to compete, and Don’s serving up a heaping plate of his signature 10-part PRT. A bear crawl down a mountain, log running and two-point planks are just some of Don’s welcome gauntlet. And the cherry on top—a 5k desert run. But the contestants only have themselves to blame. Because when you’re already amongst the elite, you have to do whatever it takes to find the one who stands above the rest.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 1 - Skinny Dip in a Snowstorm
programme.desc: Surviving Mann returns with its most punishing season opener yet. In true Don Mann fashion, the bar is raised with a grueling 10-part physical readiness test—infused with a blast of hypothermia for good measure. Don himself calls it “the most brutal PT [he’s] ever witnessed,” and it’s clear the contestants are in for a world of hurt. To push them even further, MMA legend Ken Shamrock joins the fray, bringing his no-nonsense intensity to whip the group into fighting shape. Those who survive the trial by ice and exertion are rewarded with a chance to test-fire the lightest AR on the market—if they can still feel their trigger fingers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 2 - Welcome to the Lion’s Den
programme.desc: For the first time in Surviving Mann history, the contestants undergo intense combat training led by none other than Ken Shamrock—"the most dangerous man in the world." His relentless situation drills push this elite group beyond their limits, sharpening their instincts and forging next-level tactical readiness. As a new mission begins to take shape, the pressure mounts—and the team learns that the strongest among them will earn a game-changing reward. But in a world where every edge matters, not everyone is built to keep up. Fatigue sets in, tensions rise, and the difference between teammate and competitor begins to blur. With Shamrock watching closely, only the most disciplined will rise to meet the challenge—and prove they’re worthy of what lies ahead.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 1 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The best of the best are back to compete, and Don’s serving up a heaping plate of his signature 10-part PRT. programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 2 - Special Ops Readying For Deployment
programme.desc: The CIA has called again, and Don has answered the call on behalf of the A-team. A team of special operatives are needed for a highly classified peace mission that could turn deadly at a moment's notice. To spearhead their mission training efforts, the team hits the range with some state-of-the-art SIRT pistols. Then, the gloves are off and the team gets their first course of fire for the season. After the fun course of fire, the team switches gears to knife throwing and fire building, with the help of Top Knives. It’s safe to say, these All-stars aren’t waiting a second.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 3 - Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: It’s a new day, which means Don takes the contestants' training to new heights..literally. But first, the All-Stars are split into teams for a searching mission, using Offgrid’s Faraday bags. Later, they’re introduced to the new ropes course, “The Odyssey”, to test their mental and physical fortitude, as well as their endurance, using a climbing wall. See who rises to the occasion and who suffers from "paralysis by over analysis” in this episode.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 4 - Close The Distance
programme.desc: The day starts off with some unique courses of fire that get the All Stars’ blood pumping. With the help of Rogue Ops, New Frontier Armory and Griffin Armament, the teams are outfitted with the most premiere artillery in the industry. Then, the All Stars get out of the heat and head indoors to do some CQC training with Surviving Mann alum, Randy Couture. If anyone thought it would be a break... they were surely mistaken.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 5 - Let There Be Light
programme.desc: With physical training underway, Don hands the All Stars to master weaponry specialists for intense combat preparation. The contestants face a grueling course of fire with a high-powered rifle, alongside fire-making and blade training challenges. Pushed to their limits, they race to earn points for the upcoming mission, where every skill counts. Can their new tactics withstand Don Mann’s ultimate test of resilience? Watch to find out in Surviving Mann: All Stars.

programme.title: Becoming the Gray Man
programme.desc: The day kicks off with “The 1000-Yard Shot,” and the All-Stars are put to the test bright and early. Who will “make impact” and who will fall flat? Following the competition, Don receives a call from the CIA: the mission is officially greenlit, and it’s time for the All-Stars to kick things into high gear. This moment marks a pivotal shift in their training, with lives now hanging in the balance. After a crash course in the classroom, the All-Stars head to the field for what they think is a land navigation exercise… but things quickly spiral when a group of aggressive hostiles ambushes and captures the competitors for an intense hostage training scenario. Will any of them make it out—and live to tell the tale?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 7 - No Rest for the Battle-Tested
programme.desc: With a night of torture behind them and a morning packed with PT, the All-Stars set their sights on the mission ahead. When Don introduces a 200-meter shooting evolution using Ace Precision Firearms, the group is eager—though they didn’t expect an air mattress to be part of the equation. Later, Nemo Arms ups the ante with a challenge featuring three of their firearms and a rugged desert terrain course of fire. Just as the contestants begin to wind down for the day, Olight steps in to illuminate the path to the next round of challenges.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 8 - The Best in the West
programme.desc: This morning, the All-Stars are pulled up by their bootstraps to compete for a chance to win The Golden Boy. Who will rise to the occasion in this Western-themed challenge and take home a piece of true American craftsmanship? Next, the training turns cerebral with the help of BlazePod. With mental fortitude playing a critical role in mission success, Don goes above and beyond to ensure the contestants are mentally—and physically—ready for battle. Later, the team is introduced to a groundbreaking product designed to reduce draw time while under enemy fire.

programme.title: We’re Back in Gorge-ous Colorado
programme.desc: Ziplining in Colorado’s Gorges, free falls and donuts. The Real Man show is back in full swing in Colorado. Kyle is joined by special guests and American Patriots as he explores what thrills and adventures this amazing country has to offer. And he’s just getting started.

programme.title: We’re off to a Rocky Start
programme.desc: In the last episode, Kyle took to the skies; now it’s the seas. Co-host Josh Peterson joins Kyle on a deep sea fishing excursion that ends in one of them losing their lunch.. but who will it be? Later (after everyone’s cleaned up) the gang reconvenes for a legendary course of fire with some serious artillery… and Bob.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 3 - It’s Time For a Deep-Dive
programme.desc: The A-Team goes inside Nuethix, Dr. Price’s chiropractic and vitamin operation, Clear Water and Stream2Sea to uncover how each business really works.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 13 - From Napkin Sketches to Green Frontiers
programme.desc: Four founders bring big ambitions to the A-Team: energy upgrades, no-maintenance privacy fencing, collectible assets, and a title company looking for national reach.

programme.title: Country Ball S1 Ep. 1 - Cole Weightman
programme.desc: Coach Jesse's football docuseries, Country Ball, debuts in Pittsburgh. He guides Cole Weightman, an unrecognized linebacker compared to Steelers' legend Jack Lambert. Will Jesse secure Cole's first offer? Join their premiere's family adventures.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Joe Himon
programme.desc: In Little Rock, Coach Jesse meets gifted Pulaski Academy standout Joe Himon, whose speed, character and courage have yet to bring the recruiting recognition he deserves.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Ryan Nolan
programme.desc: Undersized but talented playmaker Ryan Nolan works with Coach Jesse on strategies to earn scholarship offers, then the two square off in a fastest-shot challenge.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Richard Myers
programme.desc: Indiana lineman Richard Myers has the talent and work ethic for college football but lacks exposure. Coach Jesse talks recruiting strategy between fishing and a demolition derby.

programme.title: Mario Eugenio
programme.desc: Top pass rusher Mario Eugenio faces a painful recruiting reset after injury clouds his Michigan commitment. Coach Jesse helps him navigate the setback and plan what comes next.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Kayleb Wagner
programme.desc: Kayleb Wagner broke Derrick Henry’s Florida high school rushing record, yet an Army offer was withdrawn because he has one arm. Kayleb and his mom, Sam, share his remarkable journey.

programme.title: Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté - Part 1
programme.desc: Coach Jesse returns to Clearwater Academy International to spotlight Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté, two talented teammates with big football futures and a brother-like bond.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté - Part 2
programme.desc: The season finale follows Luca and Dylan as their brotherhood and growth come into focus, with Coach Jesse helping them show just how far they’ve come as players.

programme.title: Like A Train 1 - Giants - Part 1
programme.desc: The undefeated Knights face their biggest challenge yet as a season built on belief and brotherhood runs headlong into giants.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 2 - A Team Grows (1 hour)
programme.desc: Injuries, new players and shared loss test the Knights as friendships deepen and the team grows stronger together on its path toward victory.

programme.title: Like A Train 1 - Giants - Part 1
programme.desc: The undefeated Knights face their biggest challenge yet as a season built on belief and brotherhood runs headlong into giants.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 4 - Giants - Part 2
programme.desc: The Knights’ battle with the giants continues as their toughest challenge yet pushes an undefeated team to prove what it’s really made of.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 5 - The Final Ride
programme.desc: One win from the State Championship, the undefeated Knights spend a final week celebrating brotherhood, inside jokes and the two goals that defined their season: have fun and win a ring.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 6 - The Final Ride - Part 2
programme.desc: Championship Saturday arrives as the undefeated Knights face Lakeside with everything on the line, carrying a season of brotherhood, tradition and two simple goals into one final game.

programme.desc: The Knights’ battle with the giants continues as their toughest challenge yet pushes an undefeated team to prove what it’s really made of.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 5 - The Final Ride
programme.desc: One win from the State Championship, the undefeated Knights spend a final week celebrating brotherhood, inside jokes and the two goals that defined their season: have fun and win a ring.

programme.title: Like A Train Ep. 5 - The Final Ride
programme.desc: One win from the State Championship, the undefeated Knights spend a final week celebrating brotherhood, inside jokes and the two goals that defined their season: have fun and win a ring.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Cole Weightman
programme.desc: Coach Jesse's football docuseries, Country Ball, debuts in Pittsburgh. He guides Cole Weightman, an unrecognized linebacker compared to Steelers' legend Jack Lambert. Will Jesse secure Cole's first offer? Join their premiere's family adventures.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 13 - From Napkin Sketches to Green Frontiers
programme.desc: Four founders bring big ambitions to the A-Team: energy upgrades, no-maintenance privacy fencing, collectible assets, and a title company looking for national reach.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. Radio Host Kerri Kasem and rockstar Ashba join Don as he breaks the news to the contestants that there’s more to this yacht than a pleasure cruise. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 2 - When the CIA Calls…
programme.desc: When the CIA calls, the All-Stars answer. The team is tasked with sabotaging a drug-smuggling boat before it can make its shipment. With mission success hanging in the balance, the All-Stars take their training up a notch, starting with a lesson in maritime navigation. From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 1 - Survival Of The Toughest
programme.desc: Surviving Mann Season 1 thrilled with challenges, adventure and good old-fashioned American determination. But, before season 2 arrives, we have a new challenge for the best of the best. In All-Stars the top 3 Surviving Mann contestants will face off against 3 special operations veterans in a 48-hour no-sleep battle of endurance and willpower. Starting with a kayak, portage and run challenge, it’s time to discover if these top contestants are worthy of the name All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 2 - Hold The Blah Line
programme.desc: The challenges have only gotten started. In episode two, the two teams must go beyond their limits to come out on top. From the brutal Blah line to chopping down trees with only a small ax, it’s a battle for points that’ll take immense willpower to see to the end.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 3 - The Tides are Changing
programme.desc: After a CIA briefing and punishment for breaking protocol, the contestants get only a brief recovery before facing an afternoon ropes-course gauntlet.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 3 - All About Abs
programme.desc: Matthew and James revisit a punishing day of core work, revealing personal weaknesses, past challenges and what keeps them pushing forward.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 4 - Nothin Better Than Some Shooting and Recon
programme.desc: A nonlethal CO2 weapons course gives the team a new tactical option before their first reconnaissance mission sends them through alligator-filled water toward the rendezvous.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 4 - Nonlethal Weaponry Meets Landnav
programme.desc: Stephen and Zacharias discuss nonlethal weapons and mission prep before U.S. Arms and Athlon Optics preview new gear and the contestants tease a coming surprise.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 5 - Olympic Level PT and an After Action Report
programme.desc: Three-time Olympian Lanny Barnes takes over PT, Mike Glover leads the show’s first after-action report and the dreaded Blah Line makes its season debut.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 5 - So About Last Night..
programme.desc: Chris and Cindy sit down with Jenn and Lanny to take a deep dive into last night’s mission. If it wasn’t difficult enough to do a full day of Surviving Mann training, an overnight mission with no breaks seems to be the cherry on top. After a refreshing 2 hours of sleep, the contestants were back at it with an Olympic-level PT session hosted by Lanny. From there, Jen fills us in on a secret new product in the next episode of Surviving Mann that reminds her of... Fembots? Stay tuned.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 6 - The Range is Hot
programme.desc: The teams hit the range with Black Aces shotguns for a new tactical course of fire, then test a hunting air rifle configured with Athlon Optics and Modern Pneumatic Sporting Devices.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 6 - Faraday Bags and Spicy Buckshot
programme.desc: Kyle and Caleb revisit a brutal hamstring injury before exploring Faraday protection and getting a closer look at Black Aces products and future plans.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 7 - Life Lessons A Plenty
programme.desc: One contestant’s mistake brings punishment for the whole squad, followed by lessons from Don Mann and Mike Glover and a hands-on hollow-point demonstration.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 7 - Hollow Points and the Dreaded Glove
programme.desc: James updates his injury recovery and demonstrates hollow points in gel, Matthew relives The Glove, and BodyHz shares innovations in non-chemical wellness.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 8 - The Glove Returns and It Brought A Friend
programme.desc: The Glove returns to test a new group of contestants before Exothermic Technologies brings an explosive surprise that turns the range into a blast.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 8 - A Walk Down Memory Lane
programme.desc: Stephen and Danny revisit the season’s highs and lows while Compliant Technologies explains the origins of The Glove and Dr. West discusses blood health.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 9 - The W.O.F.T. For The Win
programme.desc: The team travels to W.O.F.T. for elite CQB training with titanium-foam suppressors, then Dr. Jenn previews the next Surviving Mann: All-Stars location.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 9 - The Team Goes To Tactical Paradise
programme.desc: PT gets canceled as the cast heads to W.O.F.T. for intense CQB training, while Jenn and Lanny offer an athlete’s perspective on the elite tactical facility.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 10 - Mission Day and EEIs
programme.desc: Mission day arrives with orders to avoid engaging the cartel while rescuing any hostages they encounter, forcing the team to execute a high-stakes reconnaissance operation.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 10 - Hippo to Hog Hunts
programme.desc: Modern Pneumatic Air Rifles shares an origin story rooted in South African big-game hunting, Athlon Optics explores thermal technology, and the tight leaderboard comes into focus.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 11 - GOAT Rifles for the GOATs
programme.desc: Mission prep pauses for serious firepower, including a full-auto opportunity, a tactical bat with a .22LR pistol, a specialized suppressor and a John Wick shotgun.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 11 - We’ve Got a Movie Star In Our Midst
programme.desc: Chris and Cindy dive into suppressors and a John Wick 4 shotgun with Genesis Arms, then Green Beret Mark Baylis shares how his nonprofit is helping American veterans.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 12 - When Pigtails and Pistols Strike
programme.desc: A planned night mission changes at the last second, forcing the team to adapt to a shifting hostage crisis and send contestants undercover for critical intelligence before the season winner is revealed.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 12 - Dummy Drags and the Ultimate Cheat Code
programme.desc: Danny and Kyle reflect on the competition as the mission nears, including Kyle’s injured-hamstring workaround, while Stream2Sea shares the sun-protection product used by the team.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 1 - Head First into PT
programme.desc: Eight competitors, from Olympic athletes to returning favorites, are thrown straight into PT to determine the new Black and Blue teams and set the tone for Season 3.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 1 - Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Chris Heaven and three-time Olympian Lanny Barnes break down the brutal opening day, including the contestants' mindset and how Don Mann's training compares with elite athletics.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 10 - Stronger Today Than Yesterday
programme.desc: Bonus planking shakes up the standings before Don runs a realistic vehicle-ambush drill and champion shooter Renee Enchautegui leads a nighttime shooting challenge.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 3 - Locked and Loaded
programme.desc: It’s go time. The mission day has come and the All-Stars have to rendezvous on a nearby island to pick up their supplies. When it comes to gear, Don pulls out all the stops to ensure mission success. From water jets and state-of-the-art fins to maximize speed, to finding a creative way to keep his team lethally armed without breaking any laws.. Don has a few surprises in store for the All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 4 - It Ain’t Over Yet
programme.desc: With a successful mission under their belts, the team of All-Stars can relax and enjoy a day of diving.. or so they thought. The CIA is calling the team back into action for a VBSS mission to secure deadly poisons that are inbound for civilians. If the team thought the previous mission was challenging, this one makes it look like a cake walk. The All-Stars must call upon all their training thus far to make it through this mission, when an unknown element threatens to jeopardize it and them.

programme.title: Becoming the Gray Man
programme.desc: The day kicks off with “The 1000-Yard Shot,” and the All-Stars are put to the test bright and early. Who will “make impact” and who will fall flat? Following the competition, Don receives a call from the CIA: the mission is officially greenlit, and it’s time for the All-Stars to kick things into high gear. This moment marks a pivotal shift in their training, with lives now hanging in the balance. After a crash course in the classroom, the All-Stars head to the field for what they think is a land navigation exercise… but things quickly spiral when a group of aggressive hostiles ambushes and captures the competitors for an intense hostage training scenario. Will any of them make it out—and live to tell the tale?

programme.title: Battle to the Finals
programme.desc: The pressure peaks as the contestants tackle the final events of the Tactical Decathlon, battling heavy obstacles, precision shooting, exhaustion and injury. After ten grueling events, four earn their place in the finals and make history by completing the first-ever Tactical Decathlon. But just when they think the night is over, Don has one more surprise waiting: a brutal PRT test involving a firehose. The road to the finals isn't over yet.

programme.title: The Ultimate Test
programme.desc: The final four go head-to-head with the championship on the line in the ultimate test of strength, endurance and tactical skill. They'll run, shoot, crawl through mud, battle through fire and push through pain as each fights to prove they have what it takes to become the ultimate champion. Then the worst weather of the competition hits, turning an already brutal finale into a battle against the elements. Four remain. Only one will emerge victorious.
